Historic voter turnout powered Democrats’ blue wave

Voter turnout reached its second-highest peak in more than a century, driving surprise victories for Democrats.

1 minute ago
3 min
By Lydia Sidhom
, 
Luis Melgar
and 
Laura Beveridge

Turnout in the midterm elections reached its second-highest peak in more than a century — only slightly behind the 2018 midterms, during President Donald Trump’s first term — with the greatest number of voters casting ballots in states where Democrats won unexpected victories.
